title: Setup
text:
Setting up requried softwares
Here will discuss how to setup the required tools and download sequnce dataset and taxonomic database.

WindowsMac OSLinux



Go to C:\ drive and create a new folder named genomics.







Caution



Make sure

your C:\ has at least 50 GB free space
the folder name is written in lowercase as shown here: genomics




Go to the docker website and click on Download Docker Desktop and select Download for Windows - AMD64. Click here to visit Docker Website.







Note



If you have ARM system then download that instead.



Go to your Downloads folder and click on the file that was just downloaded. Follow the instruction to install Docker Desktop and wait for the installation process to finish.







Warning



During installation you may be asked to install WSL. If so, please install it.



Once installation is complete, go to start menu and start the Docker Desktop. The first time you start Docker Desktop you will be asked to Login/Sign up. You may ignore it and just click on skip.
Go to https://github.com/tanzim-rahman/wgs-training and click on the green button < > Code v in upper right corner and click on Download ZIP
Copy the downloaded file to C:\genomics directory and unzip the file.
Open a command prompt terminal from Start Menu and type the following code and press ENTER

cd C:\genomics\wgs-training-main\
docker build -t wgs .






Warning



This step requires uninterrupted wifi/internet. This step takes a while (15 GB in size), please remain patient.
Make sure that you have started the Docker Desktop according to step 4 mentioned above.



Now you have to download the training materials from the google drive. Once you go to the drive link, you will see a materials.zip file. Download this file from the link below.

Click here to download the materials file

In your download directory, you will see the file being downloaded as materials.zip.
Now unzip it. Inside the unzipped directory you will see three directories named kraken2db raw_data and run_output. Move/copy these three directories to genomics directory.
Your genomics directory now should have these three directories:


kraken2db
raw_data
run_output

and some other files or directories you have download or moved here during the setup process.






Caution



Make sure those three directories mentioned above are present in the genomics. If not, go to step 8 and review the steps to make sure you followed the instructions correctly



There you go! You have completed the setup! You also have the sequence data and kraken2 database. Hurray!!!







Tip



If you face any dificculties do not hesitate to reach us at tahsin.khan@icddrb.org or tanzimrahman@gmail.com



See you in person at icddr,b.

Install Docker Desktop and follow the instructions as below.







TipInstruction for Docker Installation




write the following code in your terminal. It will ask you to type your laptop password. Type your password and press ENTER.

sudo apt install gnome-terminal

Now install the apt repository

# Add Docker's official GPG key:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install ca-certificates curl
sudo install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings
sudo curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu/gpg -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc
sudo chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc

# Add the repository to Apt sources:
echo \
  "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc] https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu \
  $(. /etc/os-release && echo "${UBUNTU_CODENAME:-$VERSION_CODENAME}") stable" | \
  sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list > /dev/null
sudo apt-get update

Download the DEB file

curl -o ./docker-desktop-amd64.deb https://desktop.docker.com/linux/main/amd64/docker-desktop-amd64.deb

Install Docker Desktop

sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install ./docker-desktop-amd64.deb

[optional] remove the docker-desktop-amd64.deb file

rm docker-desktop-amd64.deb



Once installation is complete, go to Applications (Start Menu), look/search Docker Sesktop and start the Docker Desktop. The first time you start Docker Desktop you will be asked to Login/Sign up. You may ignore it and just click on skip.

title: Whole Genome Sequence Analysis of Bacteria
text:
Overview
This course is designed for beginners who want to analyse whole genome sequencing data from bacterial isolates. Throughout the course we will introduce tools that are commonly used and basic requirements for analyzing any bacterial genome. Along the way, we will teach you the foundational bioinformatic skills






TipLearning Objectives



By the end of this course, participants should be able to:

understand what the main technologies used for high throuput sequencing are
use the unix command line to navigate a filesystem, manipulate files, launch programs and write scripts for reproducible analysis
recognize the structure of common sequence file formats
run basic quality control of samples
assemble the reads to construct contigs or scaffolds of the genome
check the quality and completeness of the contgs
classify taxonomy of that organism
annotate the genome to identify coding DNA sequences and proteins
identify core genes and construc phylogenetic tree
investigate pathogen transmission dynamics




Target audiance
The course is designed for

Students
Fresh graduates
Early career researchers



Pre requisite
people who have

Personal computer or laptop
Familiarity with R and Bash
